dct_title_s: State Representative Districts, Cambridge, Massachusetts, July 2007
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polygon layer contains the six elective districts for state legislators who represent Cambridge in the Massachusetts House of Representatives.

Purpose: This layer was created for general use by the Cambridge Election Commission and for public distribution. Cambridge wards and precincts can be overlaid on district boundaries to designate which voters fall into each district.
